dn3:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena icchānaṅgalannāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
dn3:1.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
dn3:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ukkaṭṭhaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadikosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
dn3:1.2.3: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe
dn3:1.2.4: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
dn3:1.2.5: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
dn3:1.2.6: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
dn3:1.2.7: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
dn3:1.2.8: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
dn3:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa ambaṭṭho nāma māṇavo antevāsī hoti ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍuketubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo anuññātapaṭiññāto sake ācariyake tevijjake pāvacane
dn3:1.4.1: athakho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi
dn3:1.4.2: ayaṃ tāta ambaṭṭha samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe
dn3:1.4.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
dn3:1.4.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
dn3:1.4.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
dn3:1.4.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
dn3:1.4.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti
dn3:1.4.8: ehi tvaṃ tāta ambaṭṭha māṇava yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato yadi vā no tathā
dn3:1.4.9: yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso yadi vā na tādiso tathā mayantaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vedissāmāti.
dn3:1.5.1: yathākathaṃ panāhaṃ bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ jānissāmi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato yadi vā no tathā yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso yadi vā na tādisoti.
dn3:1.5.2: āgatāni kho tāta ambaṭṭha amhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dve va gatiyo bhavanti anaññā
dn3:1.5.3: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadaṭṭhāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato
dn3:1.5.5: seyyathīdaṃ cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthīratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ
dn3:1.5.6: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā
dn3:1.5.7: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati
dn3:1.5.8: sace pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado
dn3:1.5.9: ahaṃ kho pana tāta ambaṭṭha mantānaṃ dātā
dn3:1.6.1: evaṃ bhoti kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasātiṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā vaḷavārathamāruyha sambahulehi māṇavehi saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tena pāyāsi
dn3:1.6.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko va ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
dn3:1.7.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū abbhokāse caṅkamanti.
dn3:1.7.2: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
dn3:1.7.3: kahaṃ nu kho bho etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati
dn3:1.7.4: taṃ hi mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya idhūpasaṅkantāti.
dn3:1.8.2: ayaṃ kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo abhiññātakolañño ceva abhiññātassa ca brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa antevāsī
dn3:1.8.3: agaru kho pana bhagavato evarūpehi kulaputtehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hotīti.
dn3:1.8.5: eso ambaṭṭha vihāro saṃvutadvāro tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭehi vivarissati te bhagavā dvāranti.
dn3:1.9.1: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
dn3:1.9.2: pāvisi ambaṭṭho māṇavo. māṇavakāpi kho pavisitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
dn3:1.9.3: ambaṭṭho pana māṇavo caṅkamantopi nisinnena bhagavatā kañci kañci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāreti ṭhitopi nisinnena bhagavatā kañci kañci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāreti.
dn3:1.9.5: evaṃ nu te ambaṭṭha brāhmaṇehi vuḍḍhehi mahallakehi ācariyapācariyehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hoti yathayidaṃ caraṃ tiṭṭhaṃ nisinnena mayā kañci kañci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāresīti.
dn3:1.10.2: gacchanto vā hi bho gotama gacchantena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati ṭhito vā hi bho gotama ṭhitena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati nisinno vā hi bho gotama nisinnena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati sayāno vā hi bho gotama sayānena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati
dn3:1.10.3: ye ca kho bho gotama muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādapaccā tehipi me saddhiṃ evaṃ kathāsallāpo hoti yathariva bhotā gotamenāti.
dn3:1.11.1: atthikavato kho pana te ambaṭṭha idhāgamanaṃ ahosi yāyeva kho panatthāya āgaccheyyātha tameva atthaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikareyyātha
dn3:1.11.2: avusitavāyeva kho pana ambaṭṭho māṇavo vusitamānī kimaññatra avusitattāti.
dn3:1.12.1: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavatā avusitavādena vuccamāno kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃyeva khuṃsento bhagavantaṃyeva vambhento bhagavantaṃyeva vadamāno
dn3:1.12.2: samaṇo ca me bho gotamo pāpito bhavissatīti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn3:1.12.7: ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyanti
dn3:1.12.8: tayidaṃ bho gotama na channaṃ tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yadime sakyā ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyantīti.
dn3:1.12.9: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo imaṃ paṭhamaṃ sakyesu ibbhāvādaṃ nipātesi.
dn3:1.13.1: kiṃ pana te ambaṭṭha sakyā aparaddhunti.
dn3:1.13.2: ekamidāhaṃ bho gotama samayaṃ ācariyassa brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa kenacideva karaṇīyena kapilavatthuṃ agamāsiṃ
dn3:1.13.4: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sakyā ceva sakyakumārā ca saṇṭhāgāre uccesu āsanesu nisinnā honti aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghantā saṅkīḷantā aññadatthuṃ mamaññeva maññe anujagghantā na maṃ koci āsanenapi nimantesi
dn3:1.13.5: tayidaṃ bho gotama na channaṃ tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yadime sakyā ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyantīti.
dn3:1.13.6: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ dutiyaṃ sakyesu ibbhāvādaṃ nipātesi.
dn3:1.14.1: laṭukikāpi kho ambaṭṭha sakuṇikā sake kulāvake kāmalāpinī hoti
dn3:1.14.2: sakaṃ kho panetaṃ ambaṭṭha sakyānaṃ yadidaṃ kapilavatthuṃ na arahatāyasmā ambaṭṭho imāya appamattāya abhisajjitunti
dn3:1.14.5: imesaṃ hi bho gotama catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ tayo vaṇṇā
dn3:1.14.6: khattiyā ca vessā ca suddā ca
dn3:1.14.8: tayidaṃ bho gotama na channaṃ tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yadime sakyā ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyantīti.
dn3:1.14.9: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ tatiyaṃ sakyesu ibbhāvādaṃ nipātesi. athakho
dn3:1.15.2: atibāḷhaṃ kho ayaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo sakyesu ibbhāvādena nimmadeti yannūnāhaṃ gottaṃ puccheyyanti.
dn3:1.15.6: porāṇaṃ kho pana te ambaṭṭha mātāpettikaṃ nāma gottaṃ anussarato ayyaputtā sakyā bhavanti dāsiputto tvamasi sakyānaṃ
dn3:1.15.7: sakyā kho pana ambaṭṭha rājānaṃ ukkākaṃ pitāmahaṃ dahanti.
dn3:1.15.8: bhūtapubbaṃ ambaṭṭha rājā ukkāko yā sā mahesī piyā manāpā tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetukāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi
dn3:1.15.10: te raṭṭhasmā pabbājitā himavantapasse pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahāsākavanasaṇḍo tattha vāsaṃ kappesuṃ.
dn3:1.15.11: te jātisambhedabhayā sakāhi bhaginīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappesuṃ.
dn3:1.15.12: athakho ambaṭṭha rājā ukkāko amacce pārisajje āmantesi
dn3:1.15.13: kahaṃ nu kho bho etarahi kumārā sammantīti.
dn3:1.15.14: atthi deva himavantapasse pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahāsākavanasaṇḍo tatthetarahi kumārā sammanti
dn3:1.15.15: te jātisambhedabhayā sakāhi bhaginīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappentīti.
dn3:1.15.16: athakho ambaṭṭha rājā ukkāko udānaṃ udānesi
dn3:1.15.17: sakyā vata bho kumārā paramasakyā vata bho kumārāti.
dn3:1.15.18: tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha sakyā paññāyanti. so ca sakyānaṃ pubbapuriso.
dn3:1.16.1: rañño kho pana ambaṭṭha ukkākassa disā nāma dāsī ahosi
dn3:1.16.4: dhovatha maṃ amma nhāpetha maṃ amma imasmā maṃ amma asucismā parimocetha atthāya te bhavissāmīti.
dn3:1.16.5: yathā kho pana ambaṭṭha etarahi manussā pisāce pisācāti sañjānanti
dn3:1.16.6: evameva kho ambaṭṭha tena kho pana samayena manussā pisāce kaṇhāti sañjānanti.
dn3:1.16.8: ayaṃ jāto pabyāhāsi kaṇho jāto pisāco jātoti.
dn3:1.16.9: tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha kaṇhāyanā paññāyanti. so ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapuriso.
dn3:1.16.10: iti kho te ambaṭṭha porāṇaṃ mātāpettikaṃ nāma gottaṃ anussarato ayyaputtā sakyā bhavanti dāsiputto tvamasi sakyānanti.
dn3:1.17.1: evaṃ vutte te māṇavakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
dn3:1.17.2: mā bhavaṃ gotamo ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmādesi
dn3:1.17.3: sujāto ca bho gotama ambaṭṭho māṇavo kulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bahussuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo paṇḍito ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo pahoti ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetunti.
dn3:1.18.2: sace kho tumhākaṃ māṇavakānaṃ evaṃ hoti
dn3:1.18.3: dujjāto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo akulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo appassuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo akalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo duppañño ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo na ca pahoti ambaṭṭho māṇavo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetunti tiṭṭhatu ambaṭṭho māṇavo tumhe mayā saddhiṃ mantavho asmiṃ vacane
dn3:1.18.4: sace pana tumhākaṃ māṇavakānaṃ evaṃ hoti
dn3:1.18.5: sujāto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo kulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bahussuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo paṇḍito ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo pahoti ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetunti tiṭṭhatha tumhe
dn3:1.18.6: ambaṭṭho māṇavo mayā saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetūti.
dn3:1.19.1: sujāto ca bho gotama ambaṭṭho māṇavo kulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bahussuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo paṇḍito ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo pahoti ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetuṃ tuṇhī mayaṃ bhavissāma ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetūti.
dn3:1.20.2: ayaṃ kho pana te ambaṭṭha sahadhammiko pañho āgacchati akāmāpi byākātabbo
dn3:1.20.3: sace tvaṃ na byākarissasi aññena vā aññaṃ paticarissasi tuṇhī vā bhavissasi pakkamissasi vā ettheva te sattadhā muddhā phalissati
dn3:1.20.5: kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ kutopabhūtikā kaṇhāyanā ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapurisoti.
dn3:1.20.6: evaṃ vutte ambaṭṭho māṇavo tuṇhī ahosi.
dn3:1.20.7: dutiyampi kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca
dn3:1.20.8: taṃ kiṃ maññasi ambaṭṭha kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ kutopabhūtikā kaṇhāyanā ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapurisoti.
dn3:1.20.9: dutiyampi kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo tuṇhī ahosi.
dn3:1.20.11: byākarohidāni ambaṭṭha nadāni te tuṇhībhāvassa kālo
dn3:1.20.12: yo kho ambaṭṭha tathāgatena yāvatatiyakaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākaroti etthevassa sattadhā muddhā phalissatīti.
dn3:1.21.1: tena kho pana samayena vajirapāṇi yakkho mahantaṃ ayokūṭaṃ ādāya ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ saṃjotibhūtaṃ ambaṭṭhassa māṇavassa uparivehāsaṃ ṭhito hoti
dn3:1.21.2: sacāyaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavatā yāvatatiyakaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākarissati etthevassa sattadhā muddhaṃ phālessāmīti.
dn3:1.21.3: taṃ kho pana vajirapāṇiṃ yakkhaṃ bhagavā ceva passati ambaṭṭho ca māṇavo.
dn3:1.21.4: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃyeva tāṇaṃ gavesi bhagavantaṃyeva leṇaṃ gavesi bhagavantaṃyeva saraṇaṃ gavesi upanisīditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn3:1.21.8: kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ kutopabhūtikā kaṇhāyanā ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapurisoti.
dn3:1.21.9: evameva bho gotama sutaṃ yadeva bhavaṃ gotamo āha
dn3:1.22.1: evaṃ vutte te māṇavakā unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ
dn3:1.22.2: dujjāto kira bho ambaṭṭho māṇavo akulaputto kira bho ambaṭṭho māṇavo dāsiputto kira bho ambaṭṭho māṇavo sakyānaṃ ayyaputtā kira bho ambaṭṭhassa māṇavassa sakyā bhavanti
dn3:1.22.3: dhammavādīyeva kira mayaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ apasādetabbaṃ amaññimhāti.
dn3:1.23.2: atibāḷhaṃ kho ime māṇavakā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmādenti yannūnāhaṃ parimoceyyanti.
dn3:1.23.4: mā kho tumhe māṇavakā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavakaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmādetha
dn3:1.23.5: uḷāro ca so kaṇho isi ahosi
dn3:1.23.6: so dakkhiṇaṃ janapadaṃ gantvā brahmamante adhiyitvā rājānaṃ ukkākaṃ upasaṅkamitvāmaddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yāci.
dn3:1.23.8: nevare mayhaṃ dāsiputto samāno maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yācatīti kupito anattamano khurappaṃ sannayhi.
dn3:1.23.9: so taṃ khurappaṃ neva asakkhi muñcituṃ no patisaṃharituṃ.
dn3:1.23.10: athakho māṇavakā amaccā pārisajjā kaṇhaṃ isiṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
dn3:1.23.13: sotthi bhavissati rañño apica rājā yadi adho khurappaṃ muñcissati yāvatā rañño vijitaṃ ettāvatā paṭhavī udiyissatīti.
dn3:1.23.14: sotthi bhadante hotu rañño sotthi janapadassāti.
dn3:1.23.15: sotthi bhavissati rañño sotthi janapadassa apica rājā yadi uddhaṃ khurappaṃ muñcissati yāvatā rañño vijitaṃ ettāvatā satta vassāni devo na vassissatīti.
dn3:1.23.16: sotthi bhadante hotu rañño sotthi janapadassa devo pavassatūti.
dn3:1.23.17: sotthi bhavissati rañño sotthi janapadassa devo pavassissati apica rājā jeṭṭhakumāre khurappaṃ patiṭṭhāpetu sotthikumāro pallomo bhavissatīti.
dn3:1.23.20: rājā ukkāko jeṭṭhakumāre khurappaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi sotthikumāro pallomo bhavissatīti. athakho māṇavakā rājā ukkāko jeṭṭhakumāre khurappaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi. sotthikumāro pallomo samabhavi.
dn3:1.23.21: tassa rājā ukkāko bhīto brahmadaṇḍena tajjito maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ adāsi.
dn3:1.23.22: mā kho tumhe māṇavakā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmādetha uḷāro so kaṇho isi ahosīti. athakho
dn3:1.24.3: idha khattiyakumāro brāhmaṇakaññāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya tesaṃ saṃvāsamanvāya putto jāyetha

dn3:2.1.1: katamaṃ pana taṃ bho gotama caraṇaṃ katamā sā vijjāti.
dn3:2.1.2: na kho ambaṭṭha anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya jātivādo vā vuccati gottavādo vā vuccati mānavādo vā vuccati
dn3:2.1.3: arahasi vā maṃ tvaṃ na vā maṃ tvaṃ arahasīti
dn3:2.1.4: yattha kho ambaṭṭha āvāho vā hoti vivāho vā hoti āvāhavivāho vā hoti etthetaṃ vuccati jātivādo vā itipi gottavādo vā itipi mānavādo vā itipi
dn3:2.1.5: arahasi vā maṃ tvaṃ na vā maṃ tvaṃ arahasīti
dn3:2.1.6: ye hi keci ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhā vā gottavādavinibaddhā vā mānavādavinibaddhā vā āvāhavivāhavinibaddhā vā ārakā te anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya
dn3:2.1.7: pahāya kho ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhañca gottavādavinibaddhañca mānavādavinibaddhañca āvāhavivāhavinibaddhañca anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya sacchikiriyā hotīti.
dn3:2.2.1: katamaṃ pana taṃ bho gotama caraṇaṃ katamā sā vijjāti.
dn3:2.2.2: idha ambaṭṭha tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
dn3:2.2.8: (yathā sāmaññaphale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ) …pe… evaṃ kho ambaṭṭha bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn3:2.2.22: ayaṃ vuccati ambaṭṭha vijjāsampanno itipi caraṇasampanno itipi vijjācaraṇasampanno itipi.
dn3:2.2.23: imāya ca ambaṭṭha vijjāsampadāya caraṇasampadāya aññā vijjāsampadā caraṇasampadā uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā natthi.
dn3:2.3.1: imāya kho ambaṭṭha anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya cattāri apāyamukhāni bhavanti.
dn3:2.3.3: idha ambaṭṭha ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhūṇamāno khārivividhamādāya araññavanamajjhogāhati
dn3:2.3.6: imāya kho ambaṭṭha anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya idaṃ paṭhamaṃ apāyamukhaṃ bhavati.

dn3:2.3.10: imāya kho ambaṭṭha anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya idaṃ dutiyaṃ apāyamukhaṃ bhavati.
dn3:2.3.11: puna caparaṃ ambaṭṭha idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imañceva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhūṇamāno pavattaphalabhojanattañca anabhisambhūṇamāno kaṇḍamūlaphalabhojanattañca anabhisambhūṇamāno gāmasāmantaṃ vā nigamasāmantaṃ vā agyāgāraṃ karitvā aggiṃ paricaranto acchati.

dn3:2.4.5: ārakāhaṃ bho gotama imāya anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya sācariyakoti.

dn3:2.5.1: iti kho ambaṭṭha imāya ceva tvaṃ anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya parihīno sācariyako
dn3:2.5.2: ye hi kecime anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya cattāri apāyamukhāni bhavanti tato ca parihīno sācariyako.
dn3:2.5.3: bhāsitā kho pana te esā ambaṭṭha ācariyena brāhmaṇena pokkharasātinā vācā
dn3:2.5.4: keci muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādapaccā kā ca te vijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ sākacchāti. attanā āpāyikopi aparipūramāno.
dn3:2.5.5: passa ambaṭṭha yāva aparaddhañca te idaṃ ācariyassa brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa.
dn3:2.6.1: brāhmaṇo kho pana ambaṭṭha pokkharasāti rañño pasenadikosalassa dattikaṃ bhuñjati
dn3:2.6.2: tassa rājā pasenadikosalo sammukhībhāvaṃpi na dadāti
dn3:2.6.4: yassa kho pana ambaṭṭha dhammikaṃ payātaṃ bhikkhaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya kathaṃ tassa rājā pasenadikosalo sammukhībhāvaṃpi na dadeyya.
dn3:2.6.5: passa ambaṭṭha yāva aparaddhañca te idaṃ ācariyassa brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa.
dn3:2.7.2: idha rājā pasenadikosalo hatthigīvāyaṃ vā nisinno rathūpatthare vā ṭhito uggehi vā rājaññehi vā kiñcideva mantanaṃ manteyya.
dn3:2.7.3: so tamhā padesā apakkamma ekamantaṃ tiṭṭheyya
dn3:2.7.4: atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā so tasmiṃ padese ṭhito mantanaṃ manteyya
dn3:2.7.5: evaṃpi rājā pasenadikosalo āha evaṃpi rājā pasenadikosalo āhāti.
dn3:2.7.6: apinu kho rājabhaṇitaṃ vā bhaṇati rājamantanaṃ vā manteti
dn3:2.7.7: tāvatā so assa rājā vā rājamahāmatto vāti.
dn3:2.8.1: evameva kho tvaṃ ambaṭṭha ye tepi ahesuṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti seyyathīdaṃ aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggī aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu
dn3:2.8.2: tyāhaṃ mante adhiyāmi sācariyako tāvatā tvaṃ bhavissasi isi vā isitāya vā paṭipannoti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn3:2.9.2: kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
dn3:2.9.3: ye te ahesuṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇamantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti seyyathīdaṃ aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggī aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu
dn3:2.9.4: evaṃ su te sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū āmuttamālābharaṇā odātavatthavasanā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricārenti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyakoti.
dn3:2.10.2: evaṃ su te sālīnaṃ odanaṃ vicittakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ paribhuñjanti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyakoti.
dn3:2.10.5: evaṃ su te veṭṭhakanatapassāhi nārīhi paricārenti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyakoti.
dn3:2.10.8: evaṃ su te kuttavālehi vaḷavārathehi dīghāhi patodalaṭṭhīhi vāhane vitudantā vicarissanti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyakoti.
dn3:2.10.11: evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikkhāsu ukkhittapalighāsu nagarūpakārikāsu dīghāsibaddhehi purisehi rakkhāpenti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyakoti.
dn3:2.10.13: iti kho ambaṭṭha neva tvaṃ isi na pana isitāya paṭipanno sācariyako
dn3:2.10.14: yassa kho pana ambaṭṭha mayi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā so maṃ pañhena ahaṃ veyyākaraṇena sodhissāmīti. athakho
dn3:2.11.2: ambaṭṭhopi māṇavo vihārā nikkhamma caṅkamaṃ abbhuṭṭhāsi.
dn3:2.11.3: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamamāno bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni sammannesi.
dn3:2.11.4: addasā kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
dn3:2.11.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.12.2: passati kho me ayaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
dn3:2.12.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu ambaṭṭho kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.12.5: athakho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā addasa ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavato kosohitavatthaguyhaṃ.
dn3:2.12.6: athakho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi kevalampi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
dn3:2.12.8: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehīti.
dn3:2.12.10: handa cadāni mayaṃ bho gotama gacchāma bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyāti.
dn3:2.13.1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti uṭṭhāya nikkhamitvā mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ sake ārāme nisinno hoti ambaṭṭhaṃyeva māṇavaṃ patimānento.
dn3:2.13.2: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena sako ārāmo tena pāyāsi
dn3:2.14.1: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko va yena brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasātiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti etadavoca
dn3:2.14.2: kacci tāta ambaṭṭha addasa taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamanti.
dn3:2.14.3: addasāma kho mayaṃ bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamanti.
dn3:2.14.4: kacci tāta ambaṭṭha taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato no aññathā
dn3:2.14.5: kacci pana bho so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso no aññādisoti.
dn3:2.14.6: tathāsantaṃyeva bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsaddo abbhuggato no aññathā tādiso va bho so bhavaṃ gotamo no aññādiso
dn3:2.14.7: samannāgato va bho so bhavaṃ gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehīti.
dn3:2.14.8: ahu pana te tāta ambaṭṭha samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
dn3:2.14.9: ahu kho me bho samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
dn3:2.14.10: yathākathaṃ pana te tāta ambaṭṭha ahu samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
dn3:2.14.11: athakho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yāvatako ahosi bhagavatā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa ārocesi.
dn3:2.15.1: evaṃ vutte brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca
dn3:2.15.2: aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjaka evarūpena kira bho puriso atthacarakena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya
dn3:2.15.3: yadeva kho tvaṃ ambaṭṭha taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ āsajja āsajja avacāsi athakho bhavaṃ gotamo amhehi evaṃ upaneyyaṃ upaneyyaṃ avaca
dn3:2.15.4: aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjaka evarūpena kira bho puriso atthacarakena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyāti. kupito anattamano ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ padasāyeva pavattesi
dn3:2.15.5: icchati ca tāvadeva bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. athakho
dn3:2.16.2: ativikālo kho bho ajja samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn3:2.16.3: svedāni bhavaṃ pokkharasāti samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatīti.
dn3:2.16.4: athakho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā yāne āropetvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu ukkaṭṭhāya niyyāsi yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tena pāyāsi
dn3:2.17.1: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko va yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn3:2.17.2: āgamā nu khvidha bho gotama amhākaṃ antevāsī ambaṭṭho māṇavoti.
dn3:2.17.3: āgamā kho tedha brāhmaṇa antevāsī ambaṭṭho māṇavoti.
dn3:2.17.4: ahu pana te bho gotama ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
dn3:2.17.5: ahu kho me brāhmaṇa ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
dn3:2.17.6: yathākathaṃ pana te bho gotama ahu ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
dn3:2.17.7: athakho bhagavā yāvatako ahosi ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa ārocesi.
dn3:2.17.9: bālo bho gotama ambaṭṭho māṇavo khamatu bhavaṃ gotamo ambaṭṭhassa māṇavassāti.
dn3:2.18.1: athakho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni sammannesi.
dn3:2.18.2: addasā kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
dn3:2.18.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.18.6: passati kho me ayaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
dn3:2.18.7: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.18.9: athakho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā addasa brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
dn3:2.18.10: athakho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi kevalampi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
dn3:2.19.2: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehīti.
dn3:2.19.4: adhivāsetu bhavaṃ gotamo ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
dn3:2.20.1: athakho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi
dn3:2.20.3: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn3:2.20.4: athakho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavantaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi māṇavakā ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ.
dn3:2.20.5: athakho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn3:2.21.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa bhagavā anupubbīkathaṃ kathesi seyyathīdaṃ
dn3:2.21.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn3:2.21.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasātiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ athassa yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
dn3:2.21.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya
dn3:2.21.6: evameva kho brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
dn3:2.22.1: brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn3:2.22.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
dn3:2.22.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva kho bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
dn3:2.22.4: esāhaṃ bho gotama saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
dn3:2.22.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ
dn3:2.22.6: yathā ca bhavaṃ gotamo ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ aññāni upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati evameva kho bhavaṃ gotamo pokkharasātikulaṃ upasaṅkamatu
dn3:2.22.7: tattha ye te māṇavakā vā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādessanti vā paccuṭṭhissanti vā āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti cittaṃ vā pasādessanti tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
